header.userPrompt: Provide next to this project a g8 scaffold project to initiate a Scala Threesjs project

resultJson.title: Add a giter8 template for new Scala.js + Three.js projects
resultJson.body:
This adds a giter8 template in `threescalajs.g8/`, as asked: "provide next to this project a g8 scaffold project to initiate a Scala Threesjs project". It creates a standalone Scala 3 + Scala.js + Vite project. The project depends on the published `dev.cheleb %%% threesjs` artifact and shows a rotating cube you can orbit with the mouse.

```sh
sbt new cheleb/ThreeScalaJS --directory=threescalajs.g8
```

- **Template tests:** `sbt test` in `threescalajs.g8` renders the template and runs `fastLinkJS` on the result. CI now runs this step.
- **Version check:** `three_version` must match the `three` version that `threesjs_version` was released against. A new CI step fetches tag `v<threesjs_version>` and compares against `example/client/package.json` from that tag, so the tag must exist on `origin`.
- **Renovate:** regex managers now keep the versions in `default.properties` up to date. Updates to `three` in that file are turned off, and updates to `threesjs` there are not automerged, so the two get bumped together by hand.
- **Scala version:** `scala_version` must stay at or above the version `threesjs` was published with, because Scala 3 can't read TASTy from a newer compiler. A comment next to `scala3` in `build.sbt` notes this.
- **Docs:** the README and `getting-started.md` explain how to use the template.
